title: Customs Clearance Coordinator
description: Official Madi International customs-clearance role in Riyadh focused on warehouse and logistics coordination around imports, product registration, and compliance. The role covers transport-provider coordination, SASO and Saber procedures, daily warehouse operations, customs clearance for inbound and outbound shipments, new-product registration support, material follow-up, and import/export document verification. The listing asks for Arabic and English communication skills, customs-procedure knowledge, warehouse and logistics experience, and a bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain management, or a related field.
